input.quote: 9. TRUELINK WARRANTIES. TrueLink represents and warrants that the Interface and all related software (i) is designed to be used before, on and after January l, 2000;
input.rationale: The only Vendor-side warranty in the Agreement is the Year 2000 warranty in § 9; there is no warranty that the Interface or related software conforms to its documentation, no services performance warranty, and no repair/replace or refund remedy (§ 3 hosting commitments are only "reasonable commercial efforts" obligations, and § 2(i)/3(h) expressly disclaim data accuracy). The clause therefore fails every fallback element, so we insert the shortest fallback warranty (90-day software conformance, 30-day services, repair/replacement or refund). The disclaimer at p0076 is prefaced "EXCEPT AS EXPRESSLY SET FORTH IN THIS AGREEMENT", so it does not swallow the new express warranty and no carve-out edit is needed.

proposal.summary: Insert a Vendor performance and conformance warranty with repair/replace or refund remedy
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only a Year 2000 warranty, so we added a fallback-level performance warranty: 90-day software conformance to documentation, a 30-day services warranty, and repair, replacement or refund as our remedy.

ops.text: TrueLink further represents and warrants that (i) for a period of ninety (90) days following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform in all material respects to its documentation, and (ii) for a period of thirty (30) days following performance, the Hosting Services and Support Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner. Client's remedy for breach of this paragraph is, at TrueLink's option, repair or replacement of the non-conforming software, re-performance of the non-conforming services, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming software or services.

mappings.element: Software is warranted to conform to its documentation for at least 90 days.
Services are warranted for at least 30 days.
Warranty remedies include repair or replacement.
